title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature provides detailed request logging with error handling to improve debugging and monitoring capabilities. It will log each incoming request and any errors that occur during processing, allowing developers to quickly identify and resolve issues. This will significantly enhance the framework's overall reliability and maintainability
testCases: Test logging of requests with errors
Test logging of requests with invalid data
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass and logs are correctly written to the console or a log file
reason: Improved debugging and monitoring capabilities are crucial for a production-ready framework, and request logging with error handling is a high-impact feature that addresses real-world problems
